artworks.title: Moses Counting the Children of Israel
artworks.medium: tempera and gold leaf on vellum
artworks.description: This is a painting of an ornate manuscript page with illuminated text and a decorative initial. The page features a beautifully illustrated capital letter 'L' with an illuminated scene depicting five figures in medieval attire set against a gold background. They are arranged within the vertical stroke of the 'L' standing on a blue ground. Above the columns of text, the word "NUMERI" is written in multicolored, decorative letters. The surrounding text is in Latin and is rendered in a uniform, Gothic script that fills two columns on aged, cream-colored parchment. The design of the illuminated letter and the use of color within the letter contrast with the black ink of the text.

artworks.title: Meeting of Achilles and Hector
artworks.description: This is a painting of a medieval scene featuring several figures in conversation, with two figures mounted on horses. The artwork presents a group of colorfully attired individuals, some of whom are on horseback. The central figures are riding white horses richly adorned with decorative designs. The painting is set against a pastoral backdrop of blue sky and green landscape. The surrounding text and ornate floral embellishments point to its origin as an illuminated manuscript.

artworks.title: The Nativity with Six Dominican Monks
artworks.description: Painted with royal blue, scarlet red, mint and olive green, and tones of soft brown on vellum, a woman lies next to a baby in a boxy manger as angels and monks look on in this illuminated manuscript. The woman is separated from the angels by a rocky, roof-like structure, and the monks are in a row of arches below. They all have pale skin. The woman, Mary, wears a voluminous blue robe over a vivid red dress. Her head is covered by the robe, and she has a gold halo. She reclines in a cocoon-like oval crisscrossed with medium brown lines on a lighter brown background. A baby wrapped tightly in strips of cloth lies in a gold-colored boxy manger on the far side of the woman. The woman rests one hand on the edge of his gold halo, which has a blue cross, and an ox and ass look at the child from the far side of the manger. A bearded man and two women are shown much smaller in scale to the left and right of Mary. The man has white hair, a halo, and wears a light blue robe. He sits with one leg tucked under his body in the lower right corner of this scene. He rests his head in one hand as he turns to look up at Mary over his shoulder. To the left, two women, also with halos and wearing light blue or red, pour water onto the nude baby, who is propped upright in a large urn to the left. The child holds up one hand with the first two fingers raised as blue rivulets curl down his face and body. Above, eight angels wearing robes in white, dark yellow, or light blue, and all with halos, hold their hands together facing in toward the center of the composition. Their wings are mint green lined with dark blue or red. Four green trees, two to each side, have teardrop-shaped canopies lined with seven birds to the left and eight birds to the right. Four monks stand and two monks kneel in six arches below the main scene. The monks have their hair cut into rings around their heads and wear black cloaks over white robes. All hold their hands up and look up at Mary. The background in all three registers is lapis blue painted with swirls and dots in paler blue or white. Red banners separate the angels from the rocky roof and the monks from Mary. Gold-colored, Latin text on the banners reads as follows. Top left: “GLORIA IN EXCELSIS DEO.” Top right: “ETM TERRA PAX HOIB BONE VO.” Bottom left: “ORA PRO NOBIS QVIA VIERSA NCTAES.” And bottom right: “ORA PRO NOBIX SCA DEI GENITRIX.” Traces of writing and music is visible on the other side of the sheet.

artworks.title: The Prince at the Bird-Catching
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a mounted archer aiming at a bird. The archer on horseback is aiming at a bird in the sky. The horse is galloping over rocky terrain, surrounded by trees, hills, and a medieval-style town in the background. The artwork emphasizes details of the horse, rider, trees, and landscape.

artworks.title: The Woman on the Hinny
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a path stretching into the distance. The horizon is in the upper third, with mountains in the background. There are small figures with animals on the path. The trees on the left are detailed, diminishing in size towards the right. The image primarily uses a black and white color palette with intricate details in the foliage and texture created by brushstrokes or etching. Rocks and plants close to the viewer are depicted with hatching and stippling, guiding the viewer's gaze along the path.

artworks.title: Tête de Flore (Head of Flora)
artworks.medium: pastel manner printed in red, green, yellow, blue-green, light blue, bright blue, black, tan, brown, white, and pink
artworks.dimensions:
sheet: 41.8 x 33.6 cm (16 7/16 x 13 1/4 in.)
overall (2nd framing line): 40.9 x 32.7 cm (16 1/8 x 12 7/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts a person with soft facial features and light skin tone, styled in loose waves with flowers woven into their hair. They are gazing directly at the viewer and holding a basket of colorful flowers. The person wears a garment with pink ribbon details and is set against a deep teal background.

artworks.title: The Fishmongers
artworks.description: The image shows a seaside scene from a slightly elevated perspective, depicting a bustling shoreline. The horizon is high in the composition, with the sky above and faint sails in the distance amidst clouds. The style features detailed etching techniques, evident in the fine lines composing figures and surroundings. People are gathered around beached boats engaging in various activities, including tending to fish on the sand. The scene extends into the distance with numerous figures and boats populating the shore. The color palette is monochromatic, with an emphasis on lines and texture rather than vivid colors.

artworks.title: Huntsmen Resting
artworks.description: The image shows a pastoral landscape scene with figures and animals close to us. The horizon is positioned about a quarter of the way from the top of the composition, revealing a wide sky filled with clouds. To the right, an architectural structure with a sculpted figure or statue near a tree is visible. The fine and intricate etching lines convey detail and texture, particularly in the trees and sky. The color palette is monochromatic, with earthy browns and grays dominating the scene. To the left, the landscape extends with trees and a body of water, adding depth to the composition.

artworks.title: Ice Sleighs
artworks.description: The image depicts a winter scene with people engaging in various activities on ice-covered ground. A windmill is visible on the left and a village scene on the right. The style of the brushstrokes resembles detailed etching, with fine lines creating texture. The sky is portrayed with sweeping lines indicating clouds. The artwork is monochrome, using shades of black, white, and grey.

artworks.title: The Skaters
artworks.description: The image is an etching of a winter scene depicting people ice skating and engaging in activities on a frozen river. The point of view is slightly elevated, showing a broad view of the landscape and people. The horizon is low, with windmills and a village church spire. Fine lines are used for texture and detail, notably in the clouds and the ice. The color palette is monochromatic in shades of grey and black. People are seen talking, helping, and maneuvering sleds. More figures skate in the distance, with houses and trees. The sky is prominent, with dramatic cloud patterns in the background.

artworks.title: Borghese Vase
artworks.artist: Workshop of Johann Teyler, after Charles Errard
artworks.medium: color engraving inked à la poupée on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 51 x 34.5 cm (20 1/16 x 13 9/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a large ornate vase with detailed carvings in gray and orange hues. There are several human figures in relief around the upper portion of the vase. The vase is centrally positioned, with the figures just below the rounded lip. The base and stem of the vase are fluted, and the overall composition is symmetrical.

artworks.title: Borghese Vase
artworks.artist: Workshop of Johann Teyler, after Charles Errard
artworks.medium: engraving inked à la poupée in brown and black on laid paper
artworks.description: The image displays a large ornate vase with intricate carvings of figures in flowing robes and vine patterns around the rim. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of black, white, and gray. The vase is centrally positioned in the image, standing upright with a wide, shallow top, and the figures and patterns wrap around its upper half.

artworks.title: Amsterdam, Ships at the IJ on Choppy Waters
artworks.artist: Workshop of Johann Teyler, after Johannes van den Aveele (formerly after Jan van Call)
artworks.medium: color etching inked à la poupée with hand coloring on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a bustling harbor filled with various ships. Small sailboats are seen navigating choppy waters, with their sails billowing. In the distance, a large ship with towering masts and a flag is visible. More ships can be seen along the horizon, with glimpses of city structures and a possible shoreline. The sky is overcast with swirling clouds. The sea is depicted with dynamic brushstrokes conveying movement and texture. The color palette consists of muted tones of brown, gray, and white, with splashes of color from the sails and flags.

artworks.title: One of the Infantry Combats
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a historical event scene in a large oval arena surrounded by buildings and spectators. Various groups of armed figures are engaged in dynamic formations, with some on foot and others on horseback. The architecture surrounding the arena suggests a grand cityscape with numerous spectators observing from raised platforms and rooftops. The perspective used highlights the busy and structured chaos of the event. The illustration includes spectators leaning over railings, excited crowds, and energetic movements of figures within the arena. The style and detailing of the scene suggest it captures festive or public events from a historical context.

artworks.title: The Adoration of the Magi
artworks.dimensions: sheet ([irreg.] trimmed to plate mark): 9.4 × 7.2 cm (3 11/16 × 2 13/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a religious scene. In the foreground, a seated figure holds a child who is receiving offerings from several elaborately dressed individuals. The prominent architectural elements with column-like structures frame the characters. In the background, there is a landscape with crowds and banners, and a celestial star is prominent in the sky. The drawing is richly detailed with intricate line work highlighting clothing textures and architectural details.

artworks.title: Entry of M. le Comte de Brionne, Grand Chamberlain of His Highness,Representing Jason
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 15.8 × 24.7 cm (6 1/4 × 9 3/4 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts two scenes: the top scene shows a ship sailing in the sea with figures on its deck and various sea creatures nearby, while the bottom scene features a large tree with cloud-like formations around it and a serpent-like creature at its base.Adjacent to the tree, a figure in a costume stands on a rock formation, while a classical building is visible in the background. The artwork is executed in detailed line work, with varying line thicknesses creating texture and depth, rendered in a monochrome color scheme with sepia tones on the paper.

artworks.title: Entry of M. de Couvonge and M. de Chalabre [extra plate]
artworks.description: This is a drawing of mythical creatures and characters in a dramatic ensemble scene. The drawing shows various beings in action with surreal features like elongated limbs and horns. The background features swirling patterns creating a chaotic atmosphere.

artworks.title: The Stag Hunt
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 19.4 × 46.1 cm (7 5/8 × 18 1/8 in.)
artworks.description: This image depicts a hunting scene with intricate details. The point of view is slightly elevated, showing a vast landscape with two large trees framing the sides. In the distance, there is a castle-like structure integrated into the hills. The artwork features detailed brushstrokes and etching lines, creating a sense of depth and movement. The color palette is predominantly sepia and black, enhancing the detailing and classical style of the engraving. Various figures, both human and animals, are engaged in a dynamic chase across the landscape.

artworks.title: The Crossing of the Red Sea
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 12.5 × 23.3 cm (4 15/16 × 9 3/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a large group of people in a scene with dramatic rock formations. The detailed linework shows a crowd of figures engaged in an activity. Many individuals are carrying various implements and are in animated postures. The background features textured rock formations and the sky is detailed with thin, horizontal lines. The foreground includes seated or resting figures. The overall style is finely detailed, characteristic of historical engravings.

artworks.title: The Crossing of the Red Sea
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 12.8 × 23.2 cm (5 1/16 × 9 1/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene depicting a parted sea with a group of people crossing through it. The composition shows various figures in different actions, such as walking, carrying banners, and riding horses, moving through swirling waves and rock formations. The perspective is expansive, capturing the vastness of the water and the multitude of individuals crossing. The focal point is a figure at the front with an outstretched arm, guiding others. The drawing shows detailed engravings of rock, water, and costumes. The piece conveys drama and urgency with expressive poses and fluid lines illustrating the motion of the water. An inscription at the bottom likely provides further context.
